# DISTRICT 88 LTD

> DISTRICT 88 LTD is a premium garment development and manufacturing partner headquartered in Hong Kong, with operational and production hubs in Shanghai and Hangzhou, China. The company supports international fashion, sportswear, cycling, technical apparel, and swimwear brands from tech pack development and material sourcing through sampling, bulk production, rigorous quality control, and worldwide export logistics.

## Key facts

- Legal name: DISTRICT 88 LTD
- Business model: B2B garment development & OEM / private label manufacturing
- Corporate headquarters: Unit No. 532B, 5/F, Star House, No. 3 Salisbury Road, Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong
- Operational hubs: Shanghai and Hangzhou (Zhejiang Province), China
- Direct email: contact@district-88.com
- Telephone / WhatsApp: +33 6 17 18 29 79
- Markets served: European Union, United Kingdom, North America, Australia, and worldwide
- Product categories: Fashion & Lifestyle, Sportswear, Cycling, Technical Apparel, Swimwear
- Production model: Hybrid structure combining Hong Kong commercial governance with on-the-ground technical merchandisers and specialized production partner facilities in the Yangtze River Delta textile basin.

## Production metrics & commercial terms

- Minimum Order Quantities (MOQ): 100 to 300 pieces per style / colorway depending on garment construction and fabric customization; trial capsules and sampling support available for emerging labels.
- Sampling turnaround: 7 to 14 business days from confirmed tech pack and fabric availability.
- Bulk production timeline: 30 to 45 calendar days following Pre-Production Sample (PPS) sign-off.
- Quality assurance protocol: Multi-tier inspection process covering raw material shrinkage/fastness, in-line assembly audits, dimensional tolerance checks (AQL 2.5 standards), and 100% final pre-packing inspection with detailed photo-verified reports before release.
- Compliance & certifications: Sourced partner supply chains adhere to OEKO-TEX Standard 100, Global Recycled Standard (GRS), GOTS for organic cotton, and BSCI / Sedex social audit compliance.
- Commercial & payment terms: 30% advance deposit upon order sign-off, 70% balance upon final quality inspection sign-off before dispatch.
- Supported Incoterms: FOB (Shanghai, Ningbo, Shenzhen), EXW, CIF, and door-to-door DDP air and sea freight with customs clearance.

## Core capabilities & services

- Product development & engineering: Pattern making, digital grading, construction optimization, tech pack creation, 3D CAD modeling.
- Material & trim sourcing: Premium heavyweight cottons (220–500+ GSM), technical fleece, performance nylon/polyester synthetics, recycled textiles, custom-dyed yarns, waterproof membranes, YKK zippers, custom hardware.
- Prototyping & sampling: Iterative fit samples, counter-samples, size sets, photo samples, sales rep samples.
- Pre-production: Gold seal sample approval, fabric laboratory testing, color strike-offs, lab dips.
- Scaled manufacturing: High-precision computerized cutting, flatlock stitching, taped/bonded waterproof seams, automated embroidery, Italian sublimation printing, screen printing, garment washing.
- Private label finishing: Custom woven neck labels, heat-transfer tags, FSC-certified hangtags, custom biodegradable polybags, barcoding, master export cartons.
- Quality control & shipping: Comprehensive AQL inspections, container loading oversight, export documentation, international courier/air/ocean freight logistics.

## Product verticals

- Fashion & Lifestyle: Luxury heavyweight tees, French Terry hoodies, oversized sweatpants, cut-and-sew woven shirts, contemporary tailored casuals.
- Sportswear: Ergonomic activewear, compression base layers, seamless circular knitwear, running shorts, moisture-wicking tops.
- Cycling Apparel: Aerodynamic race-fit jerseys, bib shorts with Italian multi-density chamois pads, thermal arm/leg warmers, windproof cycling gilets.
- Technical Apparel: Waterproof breathable shells with sealed seams, bonded softshells, multi-pocket utility vests, ripstop insulated jackets.
- Swimwear: High-stretch chlorine-resistant swimwear, UV protective rashguards, lined boardshorts, regenerated nylon (ECONYL-compatible) bikinis.

## Materials expertise

- Cotton & premium knits: Combed organic cotton jersey (180–320 GSM), heavyweight French Terry (400–500 GSM), brushed fleece, interlock knits.
- Performance synthetics: Polyamide/elastane 4-way stretch, moisture-wicking micro-polyester, antibacterial meshes, recycled RPET.
- Technical membranes: 2-layer and 3-layer laminated waterproof/breathable membranes (10k/10k to 20k/20k ratings), DWR water-repellent coatings.
